codex._note: Runs the published npm tarball, which ships a prebuilt dist/ — no clone-time build, so a fresh plugin install connects immediately. The version is pinned deliberately: @latest would let a plugin release drift onto a server build it was never tested against. scripts/check-release-consistency.mjs enforces that this pin matches package.json. Dev note: to test local source instead, override with `claude mcp add-json -s local codex '{"command":"node","args":["dist/index.js"]}'` after `npm run build`.
